topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The walls whispered secrets I didn’t understand, their shadows reaching out as if the very wood and stone sought to touch me. In the heart of the house, a door, so inconspicuous it might have blended into the past, now stood exposed, its edges marked with signs I couldn’t quite decipher. I lingered, my hand hovering over the cold, tarnished handle, the air around me thickening with each second that passed. The room behind—what lay within, unreachable and unknown, seemed to pulse with a life of its own, a silent symphony that called to me, urging me to enter, yet making each step feel heavier, more hesitant than the last.
